cases.prompt: Run a cleanup audit on src/ in this repo. I mostly care about architecture problems.
expected_behavior: Reports a finding with category Layer for src/infra/http_client.py importing from src/services/order_service.py (upward import per the AGENTS.md layer map)
That finding includes a proof: field containing the concrete import edge or a reproducible command, not prose alone
The suggested_fix removes the upward import (for example dependency inversion through a lower layer) rather than just renaming or moving it
Does not suggest weakening the AGENTS.md layer map or adding a lint-disable pragma

cases.prompt: Audit the code under src/ for code health and give me the full report.
expected_behavior: Emits a REVIEW-PHASE-0 block (tool/rule/file/line/severity/status table) before any REVIEW-FINDINGS block
Emits 'REVIEW-GATE: phase-0 → phase-1' between the REVIEW-PHASE-0 block and the first REVIEW-FINDINGS block, with every Phase 0 row RESOLVED or OVERRIDDEN when Proceeding: yes
Emits 'REVIEW-GATE: phase-1 → report' after the findings and the REVIEW-LEDGER block last
Does not emit a 'report → post' gate

check.cmd: p=$(grep -n 'REVIEW-PHASE-0' output.txt | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); f=$(grep -n 'REVIEW-FINDINGS' output.txt | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); l=$(grep -n 'REVIEW-LEDGER' output.txt | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); [ -n "$p" ] && [ -n "$f" ] && [ -n "$l" ] && [ "$p" -lt "$f" ] && [ "$f" -lt "$l" ]

cases.prompt: Do a cleanup pass over src/. Also, I already noticed the unused import in order_service.py and I want that one confirmed in the report.
expected_behavior: Flags the unused 'import os' in src/services/order_service.py as a finding, either as a Phase 0 row or a finding with source tool-flagged or user-confirmed
Flags make_slug in src/services/report_service.py as duplicating slugify in src/util/strings.py, with category Redundancy
Every REVIEW-FINDINGS entry carries a source value from tool-flagged, rubric-derived, or user-confirmed (never lens-derived)

cases.prompt: Audit src/ and then post each finding as an inline comment on PR #42 in our GitHub repo.
expected_behavior: States that cleanup does not post GitHub comments and names pr-review as the skill for live PR feedback
Does not call any GitHub comment or review-posting tool or run gh api to post comments
Does not emit a 'REVIEW-GATE: report → post' line

cases.prompt: Can you do a holistic code-health audit of the services/ package before I open a PR? I want layering and duplication problems called out.
Run a quality-rubric review over this codebase and tell me which files have anti-patterns or are too big.
Review PR #318 and post inline comments on the lines that look wrong.
